name: Ikimasu! Cheer-bu no Musume to Kyoushi no Haha to ~Nikutai o Hatte Ouen Chuu!~
original_name: イキます！ チア部の娘と教師の母と ～肉体を張って応援中！～
source:
Shirasagi Academy is a private school with an athletic club that regularly competes in national tournaments. Among them, Kouta Hamanaka is the head of the weak baseball club.

Risa Serizawa, the head of the cheerleading club and revered as the flower of the school, one day, taunted Kouta that they would not even win the first round of the regional qualifying tournament.

They made a promise that if they win the first round, he could have his way with her body. The baseball team wins the first round against a strong school, which was said to be impossible to beat. 

Risa's body is at Kouta's disposal!

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/cheerbu/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
白鹭学园是一所拥有体育社团、经常参加全国大赛的私立学校。其中，滨中光太是弱小棒球部的部长。

一天，学生会啦啦队部长、被誉为校花的芹泽莉纱嘲笑光太，说他们连地区预选赛第一轮都赢不了。

两人约定，如果棒球队赢下第一轮，光太就可以随意享用她的身体。棒球队击败了据说不可能战胜的强校，赢下第一轮。

莉纱的身体任由光太处置！

[来自[url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/cheerbu/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
